HOW TO PLAY

Drive around the arena, grab ❓ item boxes, and blow up everyone else. Most kills when the clock runs out wins. You respawn a few seconds after you die.

WASD / arrowsDrive & steer
Shift (or V)Hold while steering at speed to drift. The longer you hold, the bigger the mini-turbo on release (blue → orange → purple sparks).
Tap W rapidlyPivot steering: pulsing the gas loosens your momentum so you can spin around on a dime (donuts in one spot).
Space / E / clickUse your item (hold for Fart Blast)
TabHold for the scoreboard
EscPause / menu
GamepadLeft stick steer · RT/A gas · LT brake · B/LB drift · X/RB item

Green slime slows you down. You can only hold one item at a time.
